US lifts sanctions on four Indian companies over Russia trade

The US government has removed four Indian companies from its sanctions list, citing a change in circumstances. The move comes amid efforts to ease tensions between India and the US. The affected companies were previously subject to restrictions due to their alleged involvement in Russia-related activities.
